title: pseudognaphalium nubicola
intro: Pseudognaphalium nubicola, commonly known as mountain cudweed, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pseudognaphalium nubicola include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its use in treating skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
